consent.text: the tyre gate 0x086438-0x086537 is restored to OEM: the gear and speed readings switch to the ECU's own tyre value (the OEM path), so throttle feel per gear (the per-gear pedal map), the DSC / torque gear input and the tyre byte sent on CAN 0x4F1 can change, and the NC Flash / Romdrop tyre-size setting stops having any effect; on a car that reads speed from the VSS pulse instead of ABS, speed and speedo can change by a large factor (about x0.5 to x1.9, depending on the ECU's stored tyre value), which moves every speed-gated function. Read 0xFFFF9224 / 9226 and the speed mode on the car first, start from a fresh ECU read, and do a logged shake-down drive (analysis/autoblip/2026-10-04_lfh9ef_review.md F1, analysis/autoblip/2026-10-06_distribution_reviews.md A2)

next_steps: Flash this file with AutoBlip - Enable = 0 (as written) and drive normally.
Log the confirmed gear in every gear (5th at several speeds): it must read the real gear everywhere.
Set every cell of "TP Delta - Fault Threshold" to 22 (else the blip may rarely or never start).
Then set "AutoBlip - Enable" = 1 and flash again.
